icp: Founders and SEO operators who need AI-search crawler access without a hosted SKU
pain: GEO skills exist, but agents cannot get a structured robots.txt crawler map without credits or a paid plan
revenueHypothesis: A credit-free AI crawler access tool makes SearchCrew the default GEO workflow and later converts through existing hosted usage, not a new SKU
mvpAcceptance: analyze_ai_crawler_access is registered on the MCP server and in SAM
Parser tests cover specific allow/block, wildcard fallback, missing robots.txt, and empty Disallow
Tool uses no DataForSEO credits and does not add billing or a hosted SKU
Exact commit is pushed to jaimedhenriques/searchcrew
rollback: Revert the GEO crawler-access commit on helix/geo-crawler-access and close the PR.
stopConditions: No hosted SKU, Autumn product, or $10 plan.
Do not copy proprietary GEO code or edit vendored geo-* skill bodies.
Stop on secret exposure, SSRF bypass, or three failed verification attempts.

publicPatternSources: Public AI crawler user-agent tokens (OAI-SearchBot, GPTBot, Googlebot, PerplexityBot, Claude-SearchBot, and similar published bot names)

vercel.reason: SearchCrew is a Cloudflare Workers app. This increment is a credit-free MCP/GEO tool with local test proof, not a Vercel web SKU.

checks.name: vitest geo crawler access + MCP tool
